About the role

Our Agents service line builds custom agents on Anthropic Claude and OpenAI direct not a chatbot wrapper, not a per-resolution rebrand. We replace per-resolution agent SaaS (Salesforce Agentforce, Intercom Fin, Zendesk Resolve) with custom agents that run on the client s own LLM contract. AI Engineers here own the agent architecture, eval harnesses, and production stability.

What you'll do
Architect agent loops: planner / executor / verifier patterns, tool-use schemas, retry + escalation logic.
Build retrieval pipelines: chunking strategy, vector DB choice (Pinecone / pgvector / Weaviate), reranking, freshness handling.
Own eval harnesses: golden-set construction, regression dashboards, cost / latency / accuracy SLAs.
Stay current on Anthropic + OpenAI release notes; adjust prompts + schemas when APIs evolve. We treat the foundation-model contract as a dependency, not a vendor.
Ship to the client s AWS + Anthropic / OpenAI accounts. Their tokens, their data, their audit log.
Must-haves
6+ years building production software. At least 1 year shipping LLM-powered features to real users (not POCs).
Strong Python or TypeScript. Comfortable writing structured-output schemas (Pydantic, Zod) and reading Anthropic + OpenAI docs as primary references.
Has built and maintained an eval harness with regression detection. Knows the difference between vibes-eval and a real harness.
Comfortable cost-modelling agent loops in tokens. Can predict spend on a 100K-resolution / month workload before deploying.
Nice to have
Open-source contributions to LangChain, LlamaIndex, Anthropic SDK, Instructor, or DSPy.
Public writing on agent / RAG architecture.
Experience with regulated-industry deployments (legal, healthcare, financial).

The Role
We are looking for a Principal AI Engineer to lead the design and development of AI-native products across our platform.
This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys owning the full product lifecycle. You will design AI workflows, build scalable backend services, develop modern web applications, and operate production systems used by enterprise customers.
You will work across AI, backend, frontend, cloud infrastructure, and product engineering to deliver high-impact capabilities that define the future of patent intelligence.
Responsibilities AI Engineering
Design, build, and deploy production LLM applications and AI workflows.
Develop retrieval, reasoning, and agent-based systems for complex patent use cases.
Improve model quality through prompt engineering, evaluation, testing, and continuous iteration.
Optimize AI performance, latency, scalability, and cost.
Monitor production AI systems and continuously improve reliability and accuracy.
Backend Engineering
Design and develop scalable APIs, services, and data pipelines.
Build and maintain systems that process and search large patent datasets.
Design secure, reliable, and multi-tenant cloud services.
Improve platform performance, observability, and operational excellence.
Frontend Engineering
Build intuitive web applications using modern frontend technologies.
Develop AI-powered user experiences with responsive, real-time interactions.
Deliver high-quality interfaces for document analysis, search, and collaboration.
Technical Leadership
Lead architecture and technical design decisions.
Drive engineering best practices across software quality, testing, and deployment.
Mentor engineers through technical guidance and design reviews.
Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and domain experts to deliver customer value.
Minimum Qualifications
10+ years of professional software engineering experience.
3+ years building production AI or LLM-powered applications.
Proven experience delivering complex software products from design through production.
Strong experience building scalable distributed systems and cloud-native applications.
Experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), prompt engineering, and LLM evaluation.
Strong understanding of modern software architecture, APIs, databases, and cloud infrastructure.
Excellent problem-solving, communication, and technical documentation skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with patent, legal, or enterprise knowledge management systems.
Experience processing large-scale document or search platforms.
Experience building AI copilots, intelligent assistants, or agent-based systems.
Experience working in high-growth startups or fast-paced product organizations.
Technical Stack
We use modern technologies across the stack to build scalable, reliable, and intelligent systems:
Backend: Python, FastAPI
Frontend: TypeScript, React, Next.js
Data Storage: PostgreSQL, Redis, Vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant)
Search: Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, or similar search platforms
AI/ML Frameworks: LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or equivalent
LLM Platforms: Anthropic (Claude), OpenAI (GPT), or equivalent
Cloud DevOps: Azure, AWS, or GCP (Heroku a plus), Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Terraform
Note: Equivalent technologies and experience are welcome we value adaptability and depth over specific tooling.

About Info Edge India Ltd. 

InfoEdge's mission is to create world-class platforms that transform lives by continuously innovating. Our products and services are built keeping our customers in mind. We always delight our customers by delivering superior value through enhanced offerings on the internet and other platforms. Through our continuous investment across various businesses, especially in cutting-edge technology, machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI), we have built a robust system that constantly increases our predictive powers on customer behaviour, and optimizes and improves our systems. Our various teams tirelessly work together to solve problems, innovate, and create something to empower our customers. At Info Edge, people are our core competitive advantage and we will continue doing all that is needed to attract and retain the best available talent.

 

 

Team: AI Architecture - Central AI Function

 

Title: Lead AI Engineer

 

Educational Qualification: BTech / MTech from IITs, NITs, BITS Pilani, NSUT, DTU, IIITs, or other premier engineering institutes, with relevant experience.

 

Experience: 3-4 Years

 

Job Objective:

We are looking for a Lead AI Engineer with 3 - 4 years of experience to join the AI architecture team. You will work closely with the AI head Architect to build cutting edge POCs on core AI platform components spanning traditional data science, deep learning, and advanced agentic workflows.

 

Key Responsibilities:

Rapidly prototype and evaluate new AI/ML methodologies, transitioning research papers and open-source models into functional POCs and scalable AI platform components.
Design and implement multi-agent systems and stateful workflows using frameworks like LangGraph and modern LLM orchestration tools.
Validate and optimize traditional machine learning and statistical models for business-critical applications.
Write clean, modular, and maintainable Python code, integrating models with APIs, databases, and user-facing services.

 

Required Technical Stack & Skills:

Strong proficiency in Python.
Good working knowledge of DS theory, including classification, regression, clustering, ranking methods and evaluation.
Good foundation in Scikit-Learn, Pandas, NumPy, and deep learning libraries (PyTorch or TensorFlow). Should be aware with model evaluation techniques.
Hands-on experience with LLM orchestration, RAG, and multi-agent frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, AutoGen).
Experience with REST APIs (FastAPI/Flask), containerization (Docker), and version control (Git).

 

Desired Skills:

Ability to understand Business challenges and define solutions aligned to the needs.

 

Why Join us:

This is a unique opportunity to work on innovative and disruptive technologies that are shaping the future of the industry. We are looking for candidates who are willing to work passionately in a fast- paced environment and are ready to enhance their skills by learning something new. Being a part of the InfoEdge team, you will be engaged in innovations, product development, integration with mobile and social media, technology, research and development, quality assurance, sales and marketing. To learn more about Info Edge visit http://www.infoedge.in/

Design, develop, and deploy end-to-end machine learning pipelines in cloud-native environments, ensuring scalability and reliability.
